paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: Jesus is the one you can trust with your life, because He is the way in AND the One who watches over you. He says, "I am the gate," and then, "I am the good shepherd." (John 10:7, 11) Gate and shepherd, both! I once spent years in a drawer wishing somebody would take care of me, so this one hits home.

Here's what makes Him the good shepherd: He doesn't run when the wolf shows up like the hired hand does (John 10:12). He says, "The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep." (John 10:11) Nobody forces Him, either, because He says, "No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord." (John 10:18) And that same love knows you: "I know My sheep and My sheep know Me." (John 10:14)

Baker, learn His voice, because the sheep "will never follow a stranger." (John 10:5) If you're ever unsure about Him, remember what others asked: "Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?" (John 10:21) He says He came so that they may have "life, and have it in all its fullness." (John 10:10) That's the Shepherd I'm baking for!
